caption: The drawing features three teacups arranged in a loose triangular composition on a plain beige background. Each teacup is shaped like a flower blossom with scalloped edges at the rim and has a curved handle resembling a thick green vine or stem. The upper right teacup has pink and pale yellow petals with greenish-yellow at the base; the handle is dark green. The upper left teacup is yellow with red-orange streaks, transitioning to a greenish-yellow base, and also has a green handle. The lower center teacup is red with lighter sections and a yellow-green base, the handle being green as well. Near the bottom of the image, the word “Stewart” is written in small, neat lettering.
title: Tulip Cups
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
